text:
SY418
Advanced Critical Race and Ethnic Studies
0.5 Credit
An advanced analysis of critical race discourse and ethnic studies within a Canadian context. The
course
provides an examination into the historical specificity and usage of the
terms
"race" and ethnicity, their political, and their economic and social aspects.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY210
(or SY204*) or
SY213
or
SY332
Exclusions
SY452p.
